title: Breakdown
text: Based on the 2025 PGA Tour win data, the season was defined by extreme statistical dominance at the top and high scoring volatility across different venues. Scottie Scheffler separated himself from the world’s best by capturing four titles, including two majors and a Signature Event, maintained through a historically low scoring average on difficult setups. Rory McIlroy followed closely with three marquee victories, most notably his Grand Slam-completing win at the Masters. Outside of these two, the parity on tour was evident: eleven different players split the remaining eleven trophies. Winning scores ranged from a deep -24 at Kapalua, where Hideki Matsuyama took advantage of wide fairways, to a grueling -1 at Oakmont, where J.J. Spaun outlasted the field in the most demanding scoring environment of the year.
